ASTIS-authored compact C2 scalar GaussianLSI integration independently sealed before proof.
For every real C2 compactly supported function f, the homogeneous entropy of f squared under the actual centered variance-one Gaussian is at most twice the integral of its squared real derivative. Signed functions and zero mass are included. The count laws, domains, finite inequality and limits are produced internally, with no caller positivity, normalization, integrability, inequality or limit certificate.
Exact scope: Authored compact C2 scalar Gaussian homogeneous entropy <=2 derivative-square integral, signed f and zero mass included. Only f/C2/compact analytic premises; true Gaussian/count L1 and finite entropy/energy comparison are internal actual34/36/37 outputs. Exact variance1. Not full noncompact/Hilbert GaussianLSI, T2/FIRST4.6/main/work/composition. Actual37 final source/exactcommit/shared readiness is mandatory before claim or proof search.
theorem compact_gaussian_logSobolev
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : HasCompactSupport f) :
    let γ : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 1
    (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂γ) -
      (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) * Real.log (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) ≤
    2 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂γ

blind_reconstruction.text:
For every function f from the real line to the real numbers, if f is twice continuously differentiable and the closure of its nonzero support is compact, let gamma be the mean-zero, variance-one Gaussian probability measure on the real line. Set m = integral f(x)^2 d gamma(x). Then
integral f(x)^2 log(f(x)^2) d gamma(x) - m log(m) <= 2 integral (f prime(x))^2 d gamma(x).
All integrals are real Bochner integrals over the whole real line; f prime is the real derivative. The logarithm is the totalized real logarithm, so zero arguments are allowed and 0 log(0) contributes zero. The quantifier includes signed functions and the identically zero function, with no positivity or nonzero-mass restriction. In particular, if m = 0, the term m log(m) is zero and the displayed expression remains defined. No normalization m = 1 is assumed. The left side is the homogeneous entropy expression for f squared with its mass subtraction; no normalized-density or Kullback-Leibler identification is asserted. The coefficient on derivative energy is exactly 2 and is independent of f.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.BernoulliLogSobolev
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GaussianCompactEntropy
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GaussianFlipEnergy
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed

/-! Compact scalar Gaussian log-Sobolev background. The actual finite Boolean
inequality and internally produced entropy/full-flip limits give constant2.
Noncompact/finite-Hilbert extension and the SPHMC FIRST statement are separate. -/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter
open scoped Topology BigOperators ENNReal

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GaussianCompactLogSobolev

/-- Homogeneous entropy for signed compact C2 functions; zero mass is included.
All finite laws, L1 domains and limits are produced by the three actual parents. -/
theorem compact_gaussian_logSobolev
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : HasCompactSupport f) :
    let γ : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 1
    (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂γ) -
      (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) * Real.log (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) ≤
    2 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂γ := by
  dsimp only
  let μ : (n : ℕ) → Measure (Fin n → Bool) := fun n =>
    (Fintype.card (Fin n → Bool) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count
  let S : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ := fun n ε =>
    (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ j : Fin n, if ε j then (1 : ℝ) else -1
  rcases GaussianCompactEntropy.compact_count_gaussian_entropy_limits f hf hs
    with ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, tEnt⟩
  rcases GaussianFlipEnergy.compact_count_gaussian_flip_energy_limit f hf hs
    with ⟨_, _, tEnergy⟩
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
    (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 * Real.log ((f (S (n+1) ε))^2) ∂μ (n+1)) -
      (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1)) *
        Real.log (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1))) atTop
    (𝓝 ((∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) -
      (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1) *
        Real.log (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1))) at tEnt
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ ε : Fin (n+1) → Bool,
    (∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (f (S (n+1) (Function.update ε j (!ε j))) - f (S (n+1) ε))^2)
      ∂μ (n+1)) atTop (𝓝 (4 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1)) at tEnergy
  have tHalf : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1/2 : ℝ) *
      ∫ ε : Fin (n+1) → Bool, (∑ j : Fin (n+1),
        (f (S (n+1) (Function.update ε j (!ε j))) - f (S (n+1) ε))^2)
        ∂μ (n+1)) atTop (𝓝 (2 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1)) := by
    have heq : (1/2 : ℝ) * (4 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
        2 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by ring
    simpa only [heq] using tEnergy.const_mul (1/2 : ℝ)
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tEnt tHalf
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => by
    have hn := (BernoulliLogSobolev.bernoulli_function_logSobolev (n+1)
      (fun ε => f (S (n+1) ε))).2.2.2.2
    change ((∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 * Real.log ((f (S (n+1) ε))^2) ∂μ (n+1)) -
      (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1)) *
        Real.log (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1))) ≤
      (1/2 : ℝ) * ∫ ε : Fin (n+1) → Bool, (∑ j : Fin (n+1),
        (f (S (n+1) ε) - f (S (n+1) (Function.update ε j (!ε j))))^2)
        ∂μ (n+1) at hn
    simpa only [sub_sq_comm] using hn

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GaussianCompactLogSobolev
